scoring_justification: The task requires re-running DFT workflow; the agent only outputs final aggregated JSON (formation energies and elastic properties). Recomputing from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in verifier sandbox. Thus T0 result-level compare against paper-reported GGA values, with tolerances to absorb toolchain differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold formation energies and elastic properties for GGA-PBE 2x2x2 supercell models of OsN2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (formation energies) and Table 2 (elastic constants/moduli) for GGA values at 3.1% defect concentration
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper's tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual reported numbers, confirming correctness against reference solve.sh which hardcodes them.

outputs.description: GGA-PBE formation energies (eV per formula unit) for the three 2×2×2 supercell models: c-OsN₂, N-vacancy (3.1% concentration), and O-substitution (3.1% concentration).
GGA-PBE elastic constants (Cij in GPa), bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, Poisson's ratio ν, and G/B for the three 2×2×2 supercell models.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is hidden reference_match against paper-reported GGA values for 2×2×2 supercells (Table 1 formation energies, Table 2 elastic constants). The agent must compute and report the quantities; the checker compares with appropriate tolerances. LDA values and higher concentrations are excluded.

steps.target: paper GGA elastic constants and moduli
